text.description: The complete SMS text. May contain {{first_name}}. Plain text only: no URL, no HTML, no other variable. At most the SMS limit of the user message, counted after {{first_name}} is replaced by the longest first name.

sms.description: The SMS when the requested channel is sms, otherwise null.

subject.description: The subject line. One line. May contain {{first_name}}. At most the subject limit of the user message.

preheader.description: The preview line that inboxes show after the subject. One line, complementing the subject without repeating it. At most the preheader limit of the user message.

headline.description: The heading at the top of the email body. One line. At most the headline limit of the user message.

paragraphs.description: The body: between 1 and the paragraph maximum of the user message paragraphs of plain text, each one line, each at most the paragraph limit of the user message.

cta_label.description: The label of the one call-to-action button. A few words, at most the label limit of the user message. The link of the button is added by the system.

email.description: The email when the requested channel is email, otherwise null.
